en_title: GTA 6 Photo Mode Confirmed at Launch
cn_title: 《GTA6》确认在发售时加入照片模式
opus_summary: Rockstar已在《GTA6》首发时加入照片模式，玩家可在暂停游戏后进入照片工作室，调整画幅比例、光圈和景深，添加灯光并使用滤镜等后期处理工具。作者希望未来更新能加入调整Jason和Lucia姿势及面部表情的功能。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is a gorgeous-looking game, so naturally, you’ll feel the urge to pause regularly to take it all in. Thankfully, Rockstar knows this and has included a full-fledged photo mode at launch.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》是一款画面华丽的游戏，因此，你自然会时常想要暂停游戏，欣赏眼前的一切。值得庆幸的是，Rockstar知道这一点，并在游戏发售时加入了功能完备的照片模式。

paragraphs.en: The developer is no stranger to such a concept, with GTA 5 including a whole movie director mode, and Red Dead Redemption 2 eventually gaining a photo mode alongside its PC launch. It’s a pleasant surprise, then, that it's here from the get-go with GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 这家开发商对这种功能并不陌生：《GTA5》包含一个完整的电影导演模式，而《荒野大镖客：救赎2》最终也在PC版推出时获得了照片模式。因此，《GTA6》从一开始就有这一功能，令人感到惊喜。

paragraphs.en: It took 70 hours to complete my first playthrough of Jason and Lucia’s story, but I’d be lying if I said a couple of those hours weren’t spent messing around taking pictures when the mood struck me. Sometimes the light bounces perfectly off those waters off Ocean Beach, and you just can’t help but capture the moment.
paragraphs.cn: 我花了70小时完成Jason和Lucia故事的首次游玩，但如果说其中没有几个小时是在兴致来了的时候摆弄拍照功能，那就是在撒谎。有时，光线恰到好处地映照在Ocean Beach附近的水面上，让人忍不住想要捕捉这一刻。

paragraphs.en: The photo studio, found by pausing the game and hitting the square button on PS5/X button on Xbox, is impressively well-equipped, too. With aspect ratios, aperture, and depth of field all available to play with when it comes to the camera itself, a variety of different lighting from spotlights to floodlights to softboxes all available to insert into scenes, and a range of post-processing tools including a variety of filters, it’s a relatively impressive suite that I’ve enjoyed playing around with.
paragraphs.cn: 暂停游戏后按下PS5的方块键或XBOX的X键，就能进入照片工作室，它的功能也丰富得令人印象深刻。就相机本身而言，画面比例、光圈和景深都可以调整；从聚光灯、泛光灯到柔光箱，各种不同的灯光都可以加入场景；此外还有包括多种滤镜在内的一系列后期处理工具。这是一套相当出色的功能，我很喜欢摆弄它们。

paragraphs.en: That being said, there are a few little things here and there that I’d love to see Rockstar introduce in future updates. Perhaps the primary one of those is the ability to reposition Jason and Lucia into new poses and change their facial expressions. Sometimes you just get that perfect background scenery, but unfortunately one or both of the couple just look bored by the thought of it, and I have to call the photo shoot off. Life’s hard sometimes.
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，我还是希望Rockstar在未来的更新中加入一些小功能。其中最主要的或许是能够重新调整Jason和Lucia的姿势，并改变他们的面部表情。有时你恰好找到了完美的背景景色，但遗憾的是，这对情侣中的一人或两人看起来却对此感到无聊，于是我不得不取消拍摄。生活有时就是这么艰难。

paragraphs.en: I really am nitpicking, though. Much like the larger game around it, GTA 6’s photo mode is largely impressive, and I’m sure I’ll lose dozens more hours to capturing all of the weird and wonderful sights Vice City and its surrounding areas have to offer.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，我确实是在吹毛求疵。就像游戏整体一样，《GTA6》的照片模式总体上令人印象深刻，我确信自己还会再花上几十个小时，拍下Vice City及其周边地区的各种奇异美景。

paragraphs.en: We’ve got plenty more GTA 6 for you here at IGN. You can check out our review here, or head over to our launch live blog, where I’ll be doing my best to answer as many of your spoiler-free questions as you may have about the game.
paragraphs.cn: IGN还为你准备了更多《GTA6》内容。你可以在这里查看我们的评测，或者前往我们的发售直播博客，我会在那里尽力回答尽可能多的、你可能对这款游戏提出的无剧透问题。
